title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass
impact: The login form allowed unauthorized access to the administrator account without knowing the correct password.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and avoid directly concatenating user input into SQL statements.

title: SQL Injection via Product Search
impact: The search endpoint exposed user email addresses and password hashes through SQL injection.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and avoid directly concatenating user input into SQL statements.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: An attacker can inject JavaScript that executes in a victim's browser when they access the vulnerable search page.
remediation: Sanitize user input and use proper output encoding to prevent injected scripts from executing.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Customer Feedback
impact: The customer feedback form allowed an attacker to store a crafted HTML payload that executes JavaScript when an administrator views the submitted feedback.
remediation: Sanitize user input before storing it and apply proper HTML output encoding when displaying user-submitted content.
